subject: AWS co-sell: Cascade Analytics — intro & joint playbook
messages:
From: AWS Partner GTM <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick connect: Cascade Analytics (potential co-sell)

Ava —

Hope you’re well. We have a warm customer at Cascade Analytics (Morgan Hale) evaluating marketplace listings + co-sell for inference / cost optimization. AWS GTM is interested in pairing with Redwood to accelerate procurement and highlight our joint solution.

High-level ask: can you (or someone from your Sales/Partner team) do a brief intro with Cascade this week and surface a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on next steps before a formal co-sell kickoff?

Key context: Cascade is a mid-market analytics vendor, evaluating a mix of hosted + dedicated inference to reduce per-token cost and meet latency SLAs. They care about SLAs, auditability, and marketplace billing.

I’ve copied Karthik and Laura from Redwood for visibility — they’ll be helpful on pricing / marketplace mechanics.

Thanks — would appreciate a 30-minute sync.

— AWS Partner GTM
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Hale <morgan@cascade-analytics.com>
Cc: AWS Partner GTM <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick connect: Cascade Analytics (potential co-sell)

Morgan —

Great to meet you (virtually). Thanks to the AWS team for the intro. I’m Ava, Redwood’s Partner Lead for Marketplace and Co-sell. Short note to propose next steps and share a very lightweight MAP draft attached.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 5 min intros & goals
- 10 min current architecture + constraints (latency, billing, compliance)
- 10 min Redwood + AWS proposed flow (marketplace listing, billing, co-sell eligibility)
- 5 min immediate next steps / owners

Attachments: redwood_cascade_map_draft.xlsx (MAP — editable) and a one-pager on product fit (redwood-product-onepager.pdf).

Availability: I can do 9/14 3:00–5:00 PM PT or 9/15 9:00–11:30 AM PT. If those don’t work, drop a couple times that do and we’ll lock in.

Next steps I’ll take after the call: finalize MAP with owners, confirm AWS co-sell onboarding checklist, and loop in Ops for any security evidence.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Ava Chen
Ava Chen | Partner Lead, Marketplace & GTM
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Morgan Hale <morgan@cascade-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick connect: Cascade Analytics (potential co-sell)

Adding a couple quick bullets on the deal posture from our side so we’re aligned for the call:
- Likely starting point: hosted Redwood API for fast time-to-value, with a plan to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput if needed.
- Pricing: we can propose a marketplace-friendly SKU; if Cascade commits to a 12-month reserved pool we can discuss a marketplace rebate (details on the call).
- AWS co-sell prerequisites: finalized MAP, brief technical review (20–30 min), and procurement signal (PO/contract intent).

I’ll bring a rough pricing sketch to the intro so we can calibrate expectations.

— Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Morgan Hale <morgan@cascade-analytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cascade-analytics.com, AWS Partner GTM <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick connect: Cascade Analytics (potential co-sell)

Thanks, Ava —

9/15 10:00 AM PT works for our side. We’re primarily focused on:
- predictable per-query cost and burst handling (we have nightly spikes)
- proof-of-data-segmentation for enterprise customers (audit logs + retention controls)
- understanding how AWS marketplace billing vs. direct procurement will look for us

Agenda looks good — can you add a line item for security evidence & compliance (SOC 2 / data access logs)? I attached a short doc with our baseline asks (cascade-security-ask.pdf).

Look forward to the call — Morgan
Senior Product Manager
Cascade Analytics
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Hale <morgan@cascade-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, AWS Partner GTM <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick connect: Cascade Analytics (potential co-sell)

Thanks — meeting confirmed for 9/15 10:00 AM PT (invite sent). Quick operational notes so the call is efficient:

Pre-read (1): I’ve updated the MAP with owners for the first two sprints (attached).
Pre-read (2): Karthik will present a short pricing sketch; Laura will outline marketplace flow and required procurement artifacts.
Security: Sean (cc’d) will cover SOC 2 evidence and audit log locations during the technical follow-up.

Immediate asks for Cascade (to help us prep):
- Please confirm the expected daily query volume range and peak QPS window (ballpark is fine).
- Share any internal procurement timeline (PO expected by when?).

Post-call deliverables (we committed to):
- Finalized MAP with milestones and owners (by EOD 9/16)
- Short technical checklist for security artifacts (by 9/17)
- Proposed marketplace SKU & pricing sketch (by 9/20)

See you on the call — thanks everyone.

— Ava
